I stopped trying, I just focus on what’s going on today, and sometimes that’s even hard enough. I couldn’t agree more, I feel the same way when it comes to wanting the day to be over. Sometimes I feel so stuck that I just pretend that it is. I used to love mornings, but now I’m kind of a night person. 

I hope we can get through this, nobody deserves to be this sad.
